# Malady Wise

> Free daily medical puzzles and games (Medical and non-medical 'Normie' modes), plus plain-English health fact sheets, blood test explainers, exercise handouts, calculators and evidence-based deep dives for clinicians. Made with AI tools and overseen by an Australian GP. General education, not personal medical advice.

- Audience: the public, students and health professionals worldwide; Australian details where relevant.
- Spelling: Australian/British English. Units: SI.
- How pages are made: https://maladywise.com/about/#how-we-make-pages
- Privacy: https://maladywise.com/privacy/
- Sponsorship and advertising policy: https://maladywise.com/sponsorship/

## Daily medical puzzles and games

- [Anatomegaly: Daily Anatomy Quiz](https://maladywise.com/anatomegaly/): Anatomegaly is a free daily anatomy quiz: name the highlighted structure, the bone or the nerve in five quick rounds. For students, nurses and doctors.
- [Arcade Games: Basil + Clover, Stackulus and Mergeon](https://maladywise.com/arcade/): Free medical arcade games: Basil + Clover (cats, chaos and a vet), Stackulus (falling organs, daily challenge) and Mergeon (merge microbes up to a brain).
- [Arrhythmix: ECG Quiz (Free, Twice Weekly)](https://maladywise.com/arrhythmix/): Arrhythmix is a free ECG quiz every Monday and Thursday: a short case and an ECG on standard paper. Pick the rhythm in three tries and see the key features.
- [Basil + Clover: Free Cat Arcade Game](https://maladywise.com/basil-clover/): Basil + Clover is a free cat arcade game: help Basil kick everything off the kitchen bench, then survive a trip to the vet with his sister Clover.
- [Comorbix: Daily Medical Connections Game](https://maladywise.com/comorbix/): Comorbix is a free daily medical connections game: sixteen medical terms, four hidden groups of four. Find the links before you run out of mistakes.
- [Daily Trivia, Word Games and Mini Crossword](https://maladywise.com/normie/): Normie mode: free daily trivia, word games, a mini crossword, a cryptic crossword, word chains, a mystery stats card, a weekly mystery chart.
- [Glimpsis: Spot the Diagnosis Photo Quiz](https://maladywise.com/glimpsis/): Glimpsis is a free daily spot the diagnosis photo quiz: one real clinical image, six options, three tries. Tuesdays add Glimpsathon: 10 signs in one go.
- [Gridectomy: Medical Mini Crossword](https://maladywise.com/gridectomy/): Gridectomy is a free daily medical mini crossword: a five-by-five grid with medical clues. Most people finish in a few minutes. New grid every day.
- [Linkase: Daily Medical Word Chain Game](https://maladywise.com/linkase/): Linkase is a free daily medical word chain game: each word links to the next to make a phrase, like blood, pressure, sore, throat. Fill the chain.
- [Medical Games and Quizzes: Free Daily Puzzles](https://maladywise.com/medical-games/): Free medical games and quizzes, new every day: a medical Wordle, anatomy quiz, ECG quiz, medical crossword, medical trivia and diagnosis games for students.
- [Mergeon: Free Organ Merge Game](https://maladywise.com/mergeon/): Mergeon is a free organ merge game: drop organs, match two of a kind and merge your way from microbe to brain. Same drops for everyone, every day.
- [Morphemia: Medical Spelling Bee](https://maladywise.com/morphemia/): Morphemia is a free daily medical spelling bee: make words from seven letters, always using the centre letter. Medical words score double.
- [Opacitis: X-ray Quiz (Daily Radiology Puzzle)](https://maladywise.com/opacitis/): Opacitis is a free daily X-ray quiz: one real X-ray, CT or ultrasound image and a short scenario. Name the diagnosis from six options in three tries.
- [Panelysis: Blood Test Quiz](https://maladywise.com/panelysis/): Panelysis is a free daily blood test quiz: read a fictional patient's blood results and pick the diagnosis in three tries. Learn to read blood tests.
- [Sensitosis: Sensitivity and Specificity Game](https://maladywise.com/sensitosis/): Sensitosis is a free daily game about sensitivity and specificity: guess how good real medical tests are, then see 100 people and the source.
- [Stackulus: Free Falling-Block Organ Game](https://maladywise.com/stackulus/): Stackulus is a free falling-block arcade game with organs: stack them, clear rows and learn an organ fact every level. Daily challenge and world board.
- [Sudokrine: Medical Sudoku](https://maladywise.com/sudokrine/): Sudokrine is a free daily medical sudoku with a hidden word: fill the grid with letters, then spell the hormone or gland. 6x6 early week, 9x9 at weekends.
- [Suturix: Medical Word Search](https://maladywise.com/suturix/): Suturix is a free daily medical word search: find the hidden theme words, plus a spangram that names the theme. Every letter is used once.
- [Wordemic: Daily Medical Wordle](https://maladywise.com/wordemic/): Wordemic is a free daily medical Wordle: guess the five-letter medical word in six tries (eight letters on Long Fridays). Australian spelling, no sign-up.
- [Zebritis: Rare Disease Quiz Game](https://maladywise.com/zebritis/): Zebritis is a free daily rare disease quiz game: name any correct answer to a medical prompt. Answers score 1 to 20: the rarer, the more points.

## Quizzes

- [Anatomy Quiz: Free Human Anatomy Quizzes](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/): Free anatomy quizzes with diagrams: brain, skull, muscles, bones, heart, head and neck, upper and lower limb. Instant answers and explanations.
- [Bones Quiz: Human Skeleton Anatomy Questions](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/bones/): Free bones quiz: 14 questions on the human skeleton, from the sternum, pelvis and spine to the smallest and longest bones, with explanations.
- [Brain Anatomy Quiz: Lobes, Cranial Nerves and More](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/brain/): Free brain anatomy quiz: 15 questions on the lobes, cerebellum, brainstem, language areas, cranial nerves and meninges, with short explanations.
- [ECG Quiz: Practice ECG Interpretation](https://maladywise.com/ecg-quiz/): Free ECG quiz: 15 questions with real-style rhythm strips and a 12-lead, from SVT and VT to heart block and STEMI. Practise ECG interpretation.
- [Head and Neck Anatomy Quiz: Eye, Ear and Neck](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/head-and-neck/): Free head and neck anatomy quiz: 15 questions on the eye, the ear, the larynx and the nerves of the neck, with diagrams and short explanations.
- [Heart Anatomy Quiz: Chambers, Valves and Vessels](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/heart/): Free heart anatomy quiz: 15 questions on the four chambers, the valves, the great vessels and the coronary arteries, with diagrams and explanations.
- [Lower Limb Anatomy Quiz: Hip, Knee, Leg and Foot](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/lower-limb/): Free lower limb anatomy quiz: 14 questions on the femur, tibia and fibula, knee ligaments and menisci, foot bones and leg nerves, with explanations.
- [Medical Terminology Quiz: Prefixes and Suffixes](https://maladywise.com/medical-terminology-quiz/): Free medical terminology quiz: three 10-question rounds on prefixes, suffixes and word roots, plus a quick list of common medical prefixes and suffixes.
- [Muscle Quiz: Anatomy of the Major Muscles](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/muscles/): Free muscle anatomy quiz: 15 questions on the biggest, longest and smallest muscles, the rotator cuff, quadriceps, hamstrings and their nerves.
- [Skull Anatomy Quiz: Cranial Bones, Sutures and More](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/skull/): Free skull anatomy quiz: 14 questions on the cranial and facial bones, sutures, fontanelles and foramina, each with a short explanation.
- [Upper Limb Anatomy Quiz: Arm, Wrist and Hand](https://maladywise.com/anatomy-quiz/upper-limb/): Free upper limb anatomy quiz: 14 questions on the arm, forearm and wrist bones, the carpal bones and the nerves of the hand, with explanations.
- [Which Medical Specialty Suits You? (Quiz)](https://maladywise.com/medical-specialty-quiz/): Which medical specialty suits you? 14 fun scenario questions match you to GP, emergency, surgery, radiology, psychiatry and more, with real training facts.
- [X-Ray Quiz: Chest, Abdominal and Bone X-Rays](https://maladywise.com/x-ray-quiz/): Free X-ray quiz: 18 real chest, abdominal, bone and paediatric X-rays, easy to hard, with key findings and a tip for each. Practise X-ray interpretation.

- [Achilles Tendinopathy: Exercises and Treatment](https://maladywise.com/achilles/): Achilles tendon pain: the calf-loading exercises that work, how long recovery takes, shockwave, injections and what to skip.

- [Addison’s Disease: Symptoms, Adrenal Crisis and Treatment](https://maladywise.com/addisons-disease/): Addison’s disease (primary adrenal insufficiency): tiredness, weight loss, salt craving and darker skin.
- [ADHD in Adults: Signs, Diagnosis and Treatment](https://maladywise.com/adhd-adults/): ADHD in adults: how it shows up, getting diagnosed later in life, work adjustments, medicines, driving and what to skip.
- [ADHD in Children: Signs, Diagnosis and School](https://maladywise.com/adhd-kids/): ADHD in children: early signs, how diagnosis works, school adjustments, parent programs and how ADHD medicines help.
- [ADHD: Symptoms, Diagnosis and Medication](https://maladywise.com/adhd/): ADHD (attention deficit hyperactivity disorder) in children and adults: evidence-based treatment options in plain English.
- [Anal Fissure: Symptoms, Treatment and Healing Time](https://maladywise.com/anal-fissure/): Anal fissure: why it hurts, how long it takes to heal, fibre, GTN and diltiazem creams, botox and surgery, rated by evidence.
- [Anaphylaxis: Signs and How to Use an Adrenaline Injector](https://maladywise.com/anaphylaxis/): Anaphylaxis signs, ASCIA first aid steps, how to use an adrenaline autoinjector, action plans and common triggers. If in doubt, give adrenaline.
- [Anxiety: Symptoms, Panic Attacks, CBT and Medicines](https://maladywise.com/anxiety/): Anxiety: generalised anxiety, panic and social anxiety, what CBT and medicines can do, what to skip, and where to get help.
- [Arsenic: Sources, Rice, Seafood and Testing Pitfalls](https://maladywise.com/arsenic/): Arsenic exposure explained: toxic inorganic arsenic in water, rice and some traditional medicines, why seafood makes urine tests look high, symptoms and testing.
- [Asthma: Inhalers, Action Plans and First Aid](https://maladywise.com/asthma/): Asthma for adults and children: symptoms, first aid, relievers vs preventers, the newer anti-inflammatory reliever, and why technique and an action plan matter.
- [Atrial Fibrillation (AF): Symptoms and Treatment](https://maladywise.com/atrial-fibrillation/): Atrial fibrillation: symptoms, why it raises stroke risk, blood thinners, rate and rhythm control, ablation, and the lifestyle changes that cut episodes.
- [Autism in Adults: Late Diagnosis and Support](https://maladywise.com/autism-adults/): Autism in adults: signs, getting diagnosed later in life, masking and burnout, work adjustments and support that actually helps.
- [Autism in Children: Signs, Assessment, Support](https://maladywise.com/autism-kids/): Autism in children: early signs, how assessment works, NDIS and Medicare help, school adjustments, and supports that respect who your child is.
- [Autism: Signs, Diagnosis and Support](https://maladywise.com/autism/): Autism in children and adults: diagnosis, supports that help, and therapies to avoid, in plain English.
- [B12 Deficiency: Symptoms, Tablets and Injections](https://maladywise.com/b12/): Vitamin B12 deficiency: symptoms, causes like pernicious anaemia and metformin, and B12 tablets versus injections.
- [Bell’s Palsy: Symptoms, Treatment and Recovery Time](https://maladywise.com/bells-palsy/): Bell’s palsy: sudden one-sided face weakness. How to tell it from a stroke, why steroids within 72 hours matter, eye care, and how long recovery takes.
- [Big Toe Arthritis (Hallux Rigidus): Treatment](https://maladywise.com/foot-oa/): Big toe and foot osteoarthritis (hallux rigidus): stiff-soled shoes, insoles, injections, cheilectomy and fusion, and what to skip.
- [Bird Flu (H5N1) in People: Symptoms, Risk and Australia’s Situation](https://maladywise.com/bird-flu/): Bird flu (H5N1) and people: symptoms, who is at risk, whether eggs, chicken and milk are safe, what to do with dead birds, and the situation in Australia.
- [Bladder Cancer: Blood in Urine, Causes and Treatment](https://maladywise.com/bladder-cancer/): Bladder cancer explained: painless blood in the urine as the key warning sign, smoking and other causes, why women are often diagnosed later, tests and treatment.
- [Bladder Leaks (Incontinence): What Works](https://maladywise.com/bladder-leaks/): Bladder leaks: stress vs urge incontinence, pelvic floor training that works, bladder training, medicines, surgery and what to skip.
- [Blocked Ears and Eustachian Tube Dysfunction](https://maladywise.com/eustachian-tube/): Blocked or popping ears after a cold or a flight? How Eustachian tube dysfunction is treated, which nasal sprays help, ear-popping tips, when to see a GP.
- [Bluebottle and Jellyfish Sting First Aid](https://maladywise.com/marine-stings/): Bluebottle sting? Hot water, not vinegar. First aid for bluebottles, box jellyfish, Irukandji, stingrays and blue-ringed octopus, per Australian guidance.
- [Boils: Treatment, Causes and Recurrent Boils](https://maladywise.com/boils/): How to treat a boil, when it needs draining or antibiotics, and how to stop boils coming back. Plain-English guide, overseen by an Australian GP.
- [BPPV Vertigo: The Epley Manoeuvre and What Works](https://maladywise.com/bppv/): BPPV, the commonest cause of spinning vertigo: how the Epley manoeuvre works, how often it returns, warning signs and why tablets don’t fix it.

- [Bunions (Hallux Valgus): Causes and Treatment](https://maladywise.com/bunions/): Bunions (hallux valgus): a bony bump at the base of the big toe. What causes them, shoes and self-care that help, and when surgery is worth it.

- [GP Tools: Calculators, AI Scribes and Apps](https://maladywise.com/tools/): GP tools A–Z: free calculators built here, plus AI scribes, clinical calculators, diagnosis aids and Australian references.
- [Iron Infusion Calculator (Ferinject, Ganzoni)](https://maladywise.com/tools/iron-infusion/): Iron infusion dose calculator for clinicians: Ganzoni iron deficit and the ferric carboxymaltose simplified dosing table from the Australian PI.
- [Ovulation Calculator: Your Fertile Window](https://maladywise.com/tools/ovulation-calculator/): Free ovulation calculator: estimate your fertile window and ovulation date for the next 3 cycles from your period and cycle length, with honest caveats.
- [Pregnancy Week Calculator: How Many Weeks?](https://maladywise.com/tools/pregnancy-week-calculator/): Free pregnancy week calculator: see how many weeks and days pregnant you are today, your trimester, due date and upcoming Australian scans and tests.
- [Vertigo Sorter: Dizziness Assessment Tool (TiTrATE)](https://maladywise.com/tools/vertigo/): A step-by-step vertigo sorter for clinicians, using timing and triggers: BPPV, vestibular migraine, Ménière’s, vestibular neuritis, stroke and HINTS.
- [What Health Checks Do I Need? Free Australian Checklist](https://maladywise.com/tools/health-check/): Free personal checklist of the screening tests, check-ups and vaccines recommended in Australia for your age, sex and history, based on the RACGP Red Book.

## Comparisons

- [Cold vs Flu: How to Tell the Difference](https://maladywise.com/compare/cold-vs-flu/): Cold or flu? How to tell the difference: sudden fever and aches versus a gradual runny nose, how long each lasts, antivirals, flu vaccines in Australia.
- [Ibuprofen vs Paracetamol: Which Painkiller Is Best?](https://maladywise.com/compare/ibuprofen-vs-paracetamol/): Ibuprofen vs paracetamol: which works better for back pain, period pain, arthritis and fever in children, who should avoid each, pregnancy, and taking both together.
- [Medicine and Symptom Comparisons: X vs Y](https://maladywise.com/compare/): Plain-English comparisons: semaglutide vs tirzepatide, ibuprofen vs paracetamol, cold vs flu, sertraline vs escitalopram and vitamin D3 vs D2.
- [Semaglutide vs Tirzepatide (Ozempic vs Mounjaro)](https://maladywise.com/compare/ozempic-vs-mounjaro/): Semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy) vs tirzepatide (Mounjaro): head-to-head weight loss in SURMOUNT-5, diabetes results, side effects and PBS status in Australia.
- [Sertraline vs Escitalopram (Zoloft vs Lexapro)](https://maladywise.com/compare/sertraline-vs-escitalopram/): Sertraline (Zoloft) vs escitalopram (Lexapro): how well they work, side effects, heart rhythm (QT), interactions, pregnancy and breastfeeding, and PBS cost.
- [Vitamin D3 vs D2: Which Supplement Is Better?](https://maladywise.com/compare/vitamin-d3-vs-d2/): Vitamin D3 (colecalciferol) vs D2 (ergocalciferol): which raises blood levels better, daily vs big doses, vegan sources, who needs a supplement and how much.
